content.text:
There are two `NotificationChannel` interfaces — one in the monitoring module and one in the application module. Here are all implementing classes:

**`monitoring/.../NotificationChannel`:**
- `SlackNotificationChannel` in monitoring module

**`application/.../NotificationChannel<R, T>`:**
- `MicrosoftTeamsNotificationChannel`
- `SmsNotificationChannel`
- `EmailNotificationChannel`
- `MobileAppNotificationChannel`
- `SlackNotificationChannel` (application module, separate from monitoring)
- `DefaultNotificationCenter` (also implements `NotificationCenter`)

RELEVANT_FILES_START
monitoring/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/monitoring/notification/channels/impl/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements monitoring NotificationChannel
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MicrosoftTeamsNotificationChannel.java | implements NotificationChannel<MicrosoftTeamsNotificationTargetConfig, MicrosoftTeamsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SmsNotificationChannel.java | implements NotificationChannel<User, SmsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/EmailNotificationChannel.java | implements NotificationChannel<User, EmailDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MobileAppNotificationChannel.java | implements NotificationChannel<User, MobileAppDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements NotificationChannel<SlackConversation, SlackDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/DefaultNotificationCenter.java | implements NotificationChannel<User, WebDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
RELEVANT_FILES_END
